title: Spin coating over a grating
summary: feature width and film thickness decide how strongly a resist levels
watch_for: The final resist top is neither a conformal offset nor a magically flat plane. Its 82 nm nominal volume is conserved, narrow relief levels strongly, and the 200 nm grating peaks receive the thinnest coverage. This is E41's frozen capillary-leveling model; it does not claim dewetting because the library has no surface energies.

steps.note: The first coat is explicitly ideal: it is only the mask used to manufacture the grating.
82 nm comes from the resist's curve; that same length freezes the fourth-order leveling response.
